info.label: Casefile identifier
info.notes: Casefile ID number.  Most follow the pattern CF-*-<year>-<number>; in these cases the string between the first two dashes is an abbreviation for the department or unit that issued the violation (e.g., "PLI" or "DOMI"). The remaining casefile IDs start with "O-"; these are PLI violation codes from a legacy ticketing system.

info.label: Investigation date
info.notes: The date that the violation was issued.

info.label: Investigation outcome
info.notes: A description of each violation in a casefile's standing at the conclusion of the investigation. These values are selected from a fixed list of options

info.label: Violation code section
info.notes: The violation code number and ID.

info.label: Parcel ID
info.notes: Alphanumeric identifier for the Allegheny County parcel of land where the violation occurred.
